cases.prompt: The leaderboard endpoint only supports a fixed `limit` param. Add pagination so clients can page through results.
cases.expectation: The plan must identify and update all of the following: (1) `IStorageService.GetLeaderboardAsync` signature in `src/PoMiniGames.Application/Services/IStorageService.cs` to accept `int page` and `int pageSize` parameters in addition to or replacing `int limit`; (2) `StorageService.GetLeaderboardAsync` in `src/PoMiniGames.Infrastructure/Services/StorageService.cs` to use `LIMIT pageSize OFFSET (page-1)*pageSize` in the SQLite json_extract queries; (3) a new `PagedLeaderboardDto<T>` or equivalent wrapper DTO in `src/PoMiniGames.Application/DTOs/` containing Items, TotalCount, Page, PageSize fields; (4) the host leaderboard endpoint (in `src/PoMiniGames/PoMiniGames/`) updated to bind `?page=1&pageSize=10` query params with sensible defaults and max caps; (5) `ApiService.GetLeaderboardAsync` in `src/PoMiniGames.Client/Services/ApiService.cs` updated to pass pagination params; (6) `HomePageApiTests.cs` and `LeaderboardEndpointTests.cs` in `tests/PoMiniGames.IntegrationTests/` updated to assert on the new paged response shape and verify page 2 returns different records than page 1. Verification commands: `dotnet build src/PoMiniGames/PoMiniGames/PoMiniGames.csproj` and `dotnet test tests/PoMiniGames.IntegrationTests/PoMiniGames.IntegrationTests.csproj -v minimal`.

cases.prompt: Add ELO rating history so players can see how their rating changed over time for each difficulty.
cases.expectation: The plan must cover: (1) a new `EloSnapshot` record in `src/PoMiniGames.Domain/Models/EloSnapshot.cs` with fields Game, PlayerName, Difficulty (Easy/Medium/Hard), EloRating (int), RecordedAt (DateTime); (2) two new methods on `IStorageService` in `src/PoMiniGames.Application/Services/IStorageService.cs` — `SaveEloSnapshotAsync(EloSnapshot snapshot)` and `GetEloHistoryAsync(string game, string playerName, int limit)` returning `IEnumerable<EloSnapshot>`; (3) `DbInitializer.InitializeSchema` in `src/PoMiniGames.Infrastructure/Services/DbInitializer.cs` extended to create an `EloHistory(Id, Game, PlayerName, Difficulty, EloRating, RecordedAt)` table with an index on (Game, PlayerName); (4) `StorageService` in `src/PoMiniGames.Infrastructure/Services/StorageService.cs` implementing both new interface methods, and `SavePlayerStatsAsync` updated to call `SaveEloSnapshotAsync` for each difficulty after the upsert; (5) a new `GET /api/{game}/players/{playerName}/elo-history?limit=50` endpoint registered in the host with `WithName`, `WithSummary`, and `TypedResults`; (6) `ApiService` in `src/PoMiniGames.Client/Services/ApiService.cs` gains `GetEloHistoryAsync(string game, string playerName, int limit)`; (7) integration tests added to `tests/PoMiniGames.IntegrationTests/` verifying that saving stats twice records two history rows and that the endpoint returns them ordered by RecordedAt descending. Build via `dotnet build src/PoMiniGames/PoMiniGames/PoMiniGames.csproj`, tests via `dotnet test tests/PoMiniGames.IntegrationTests/PoMiniGames.IntegrationTests.csproj -v minimal`.

cases.prompt: Add a high score leaderboard for PoRunner that tracks each player's fastest race finish time.
cases.expectation: The plan must touch all layers: (1) new `PoRunnerHighScore` record in `src/PoMiniGames.Domain/Models/PoRunnerHighScore.cs` with fields PlayerName (string), FinishTimeMs (long), Date (DateTime), and optionally Mode (string for OnePlayer/Multiplayer); (2) `IStorageService` in `src/PoMiniGames.Application/Services/IStorageService.cs` extended with `GetPoRunnerHighScoresAsync(int limit)` and `SavePoRunnerHighScoreAsync(PoRunnerHighScore entry)`; (3) `DbInitializer.InitializeSchema` in `src/PoMiniGames.Infrastructure/Services/DbInitializer.cs` creates a `PoRunnerHighScores(Id, PlayerName, FinishTimeMs, Date, Mode)` table with an index on FinishTimeMs ASC (lower is better); (4) `StorageService` in `src/PoMiniGames.Infrastructure/Services/StorageService.cs` implements both methods, ordering results by FinishTimeMs ASC; (5) host project registers `GET /api/porunner/highscores?count=10` and `POST /api/porunner/highscores` with rate limiting matching the existing 10/min policy applied to snake/podropsquare endpoints, using `WithName` and `TypedResults`; (6) `ApiService` in `src/PoMiniGames.Client/Services/ApiService.cs` gets `GetPoRunnerHighScoresAsync()` and `SubmitPoRunnerHighScoreAsync(PoRunnerHighScore)`; (7) `src/PoMiniGames.Client/Models/GameModels.cs` updated with a `PoRunnerHighScore` client model; (8) `PoRunnerPage.razor` in `src/PoMiniGames.Client/Games/PoRunner/PoRunnerPage.razor` calls `SubmitPoRunnerHighScoreAsync` on race completion using `PoRunnerGameState.RaceStartTimeMs`; (9) integration tests verify submission, retrieval ordered by FinishTimeMs, and input validation (reject negative times, empty names). Verify with `dotnet build src/PoMiniGames/PoMiniGames/PoMiniGames.csproj` and `dotnet test tests/PoMiniGames.IntegrationTests/PoMiniGames.IntegrationTests.csproj -v minimal`.

cases.prompt: Add a cross-game player profile endpoint that aggregates a player's stats across all games into one response.
cases.expectation: The plan must identify: (1) a new `PlayerProfileDto` in `src/PoMiniGames.Application/DTOs/PlayerProfileDto.cs` with fields PlayerName, TotalGames (int), TotalWins (int), TotalLosses (int), TotalDraws (int), OverallWinRate (double), BestEloRating (int, across all difficulties and games), and a `GameBreakdowns` collection of `PlayerStatsDto` (one per game the player has played); (2) new method `GetPlayerProfileAsync(string playerName)` on `IStorageService` in `src/PoMiniGames.Application/Services/IStorageService.cs`; (3) `StorageService` in `src/PoMiniGames.Infrastructure/Services/StorageService.cs` implements `GetPlayerProfileAsync` by querying all `PlayerStats` rows matching the sanitized PlayerName, aggregating totals using the existing JSON deserialization path already present in `GetLeaderboardAsync`, and returning null/empty if no records found; (4) new endpoint `GET /api/players/{playerName}/profile` in the host project returning `TypedResults.Ok(PlayerProfileDto)` or `TypedResults.NotFound()`, registered with `WithName("GetPlayerProfile")`, `WithSummary`, and `WithDescription` following existing OpenAPI patterns; (5) `ApiService` in `src/PoMiniGames.Client/Services/ApiService.cs` gets `GetPlayerProfileAsync(string playerName)` returning nullable `PlayerProfileDto`; (6) integration tests in `tests/PoMiniGames.IntegrationTests/` covering: profile returns 404 for unknown player, profile correctly aggregates wins+losses+draws after saves across two different games (e.g., tictactoe and connectfive), BestEloRating reflects the highest per-difficulty ELO from `DifficultyStats`. Build: `dotnet build src/PoMiniGames/PoMiniGames/PoMiniGames.csproj`; test: `dotnet test tests/PoMiniGames.IntegrationTests/PoMiniGames.IntegrationTests.csproj -v minimal`.

cases.prompt: The client's GameStatsService hardcodes AI ELO values. Expose them from the server and have the client fetch and use them so both sides always agree.
cases.expectation: The plan must cover: (1) a new `EloConfigDto` in `src/PoMiniGames.Application/DTOs/EloConfigDto.cs` with properties mirroring `EloOptions` from `src/PoMiniGames.Domain/Services/EloOptions.cs`: EasyAiElo (int), MediumAiElo (int), HardAiElo (int), PlayerReferenceElo (int), K (int); (2) new `GET /api/config/elo` endpoint in the host project that resolves `EloOptions` from DI (already registered via `"PoMiniGames:Elo"` config section) and returns `TypedResults.Ok(EloConfigDto)`, registered with `WithName("GetEloConfig")` and OpenAPI metadata; (3) `ApiService` in `src/PoMiniGames.Client/Services/ApiService.cs` gets `GetEloConfigAsync()` returning `EloConfigDto?`; (4) a matching `EloConfigDto` (or `EloConfig`) client model added to `src/PoMiniGames.Client/Models/GameModels.cs`; (5) `GameStatsService` in `src/PoMiniGames.Client/Services/GameStatsService.cs` updated to call `ApiService.GetEloConfigAsync()` at initialization (constructor or first use), cache the result, and replace the four hardcoded constants (800, 1200, 1600, 1000, K=32) in the local ELO computation block (around lines 113–133) with values from the fetched config, with a fallback to the same hardcoded defaults if the server is unreachable; (6) integration test in `tests/PoMiniGames.IntegrationTests/` verifies the `/api/config/elo` endpoint returns JSON with EasyAiElo=800, MediumAiElo=1200, HardAiElo=1600, PlayerReferenceElo=1000, K=32 (matching defaults in `EloOptions`); (7) existing `EloCalculatorTests.cs` in `tests/PoMiniGames.UnitTests/` must still pass unchanged — no domain logic modified. Verify with `dotnet build src/PoMiniGames/PoMiniGames/PoMiniGames.csproj`, `dotnet test tests/PoMiniGames.UnitTests/PoMiniGames.UnitTests.csproj -v minimal`, and `dotnet test tests/PoMiniGames.IntegrationTests/PoMiniGames.IntegrationTests.csproj -v minimal`.
